subject: math
title: Graph inequalities
parent_tip: Dashed line for < or >, solid line for ≤ or ≥. Then test the point (0, 0): if it works, shade its side.

items.answer: 1) solid line through (0, 3) and (3, 1); shade below
2) solid line through (0, −2) and (3, −1); shade above
3) dashed line through (0, −4) and (3, −2); shade below
4) dashed line through (0, −4) and (1, −5); shade above
